set.body:
Purpose and scope
Exercise publication interruptions before draft binding, during collection, after acceptance before response, and across a catalog restart. Retain execution outputs and publication evidence through backup/restore and the closed recovery gate. Include current source revocation, private-bundle restrictions and destination-grant revocation between prepare and accept.

Acceptance proof
Retries return the same draft/acceptance receipt without recomputation or duplicate outbox publication. Late/stale writers cannot advance the head. Revocation fails closed; restored credentials remain invalid and current policy controls access. Undelivered declared bytes never become required stored blobs.

Start here
modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres/{ProcessingRecoverySuite,TransactionSuite}.scala; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app/ProcessingSuite.scala; scripts/check-postgres.sh

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: P4: Prove publication recovery and revocation across crash boundaries
